notes:
Summary: ConvergentEdge builds low-latency personalization and transaction-ranking features for B2C finance products. They need sub-200ms p95 text completions for chat assistants, and <50ms p95 for reranking endpoint used inline with user interactions. Highly cost-sensitive: goal is to keep cost per active session < $0.002/token equivalent under peak load. Interested in Redwood Optimize for batching/caching/quantization guidance and an objective perf benchmark run.

Key constraints:
- Strict VPC + KMS; some datasets must remain in US regions only (data residency).
- SOC2 in progress; security questionnaire requested.
- Legal needs a DPA addendum for embeddings storage.

Technical requirements (from call 2025-02-11):
- Workloads: chat (multi-turn), real-time reranking for search/autocomplete, candidate rerank at 1000 qps traffic bursts.
- Targets: chat p95 < 200ms (single-turn hope), rerank p95 < 50ms end-to-end, tail latency critical.
- Throughput: sustained 4000 tokens/s per service during peak, spike to 12k tokens/s for short bursts.
- Model preference: quantized Llama2-13B or similar 8-bit variants; open to distilled decoder models.
- Routing/fallback: Primary model on Dedicated pool, fallback to hosted smaller quantized variant; automatic KV/prefix cache for session context.

Meetings / timeline:
- 2025-01-08: Initial inbound trial request (Avery).
- 2025-01-22: Discovery call w/ engineering (Avery, Ravi) — collected perf targets and security checklist.
- 2025-02-05: Demo of Redwood Console + basic perf numbers; CE asked for deterministic bench harness.
- 2025-02-11: Deep technical session (Fireflies ff-20250211-77a4). Discussed batching, cache policies, quantization tradeoffs.
- 2025-02-20: Provided draft POC runbook and pricing estimate (Drive link).
- 2025-02-25: Security team submitted questionnaire; awaiting SOC2 artifacts.

POC scope (requested):
- 48h perf benchmarking on a Dedicated GPU pool: 1) baseline float model, 2) int8 quantized variant, 3) caching enabled + batching tuned. Output: p50/p95/p99 latencies, tokens/sec, cost per 1M tokens.
- Redwood Optimize to suggest batch sizes, KV cache TTLs, and quantization profile.
- Measure quality regressions on standard prompt set (10k prompts) and track BLEU/ROUGE-ish metrics (CE custom eval).

Sales notes / quotes:
- "We need predictable tail latency — user dropoffs at 300ms are killing engagement."
- Cost sensitivity repeated: "If we can't get down to half our current per-session cost we won't move off DIY infra."

Next steps (short):
- Confirm Dedicated GPU spec + dates for 48h run (Ravi owners).
- Send SOC2 in-progress artefacts template and DPA redline to legal.
- Schedule 1h benchmark kickoff with CE infra team (target 2025-03-03).

Other pragmatics:
- Suggest start with 13B q8_0 for throughput parity; if quality loss >2% swap to 13B q4_0 and re-run.
- Recommend telemetry hooks and token-level cost breakdown enabled during POC.
- Jira INF-1219 created to track quantization regression issue discovered in internal sim.

Notes tone: fragments, shorthand, priorities.
